body.title: Pipeline core: job, prepare, envelope and driver steps
body.summary: Create src/workflow/review-pipeline. Move packIntoBatches (re-exported at its old path) and grow the delivered ReviewJob into ReviewPipelineJob, deleting review-job.ts and moving and rewriting its tests. Add the contracts sc1-sc4 and sc6 and the immutable snapshot (claims and evidence written once). Prepare: measure rendered calls, the single path, grouping by relation kind precedence (calls, same-file, same-module, references), the neighbourSummary slot, division with zero atoms, and AtomTooLargeError on a neighbour-free lower bound. Also: the envelope and fresh callIds; nextCalls; applyAnswer (schema, then validate(answer, call)); applyFailure (refusal re-division within maxChars, else half; one re-issue for transient, stall, mismatch and invalid answer); runStage; the per-stage failure policies; the deadlineAt rule (per-session limit times planned sessions, 30-minute cap per session); and the optional pipelineCalls on DimensionResult and ReviewReport.
acceptanceChecks: Under the limit, the plan is single and the calls carry today's messages and schema inside the envelope.
A missing or wrong callId, a transient error, a stall or an invalid answer is re-issued once under a new callId, and no prompt hash repeats.
A size refusal re-divides exactly the carried atoms and notes; the refused prompt is never resent.

tests.name: src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a review under the limit is one chunk whose calls carry today's messages and schema inside the envelope'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a missing or wrong callId is rejected and the call re-issued once under a new callId; no prompt hash repeats'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a transient error, a stall or an invalid answer is re-issued once under a new callId, then the stage failure policy applies'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a size refusal re-divides exactly the atoms and notes the call carried and never resends the prompt'
src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'refusal re-planning reads only the job snapshot, so a changed source between turns cannot change the material'

src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'runStage commits a deterministic stage's output; extract claims and probe evidence enter the snapshot once and re-planning reads only them'

src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pipeline-job.test.ts: 'a re-issued reviewer-session call gets only the remaining time to the job deadline; past the deadline no call is issued and the review fails with today's message'

src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/pack-into-batches.test.ts and src/workflow/review-pipeline/__tests__/review-job-core.test.ts: the delivered ISSUE-aef82b03 tests, moved and rewritten to the new API
